title: Howard Finster's Paradise Garden

services.name: Lessons Plans
services.desc: Using the pathways of Paradise Garden as inspiration, we can make our own embedded tiles, and learn about one of the processes of making art that Howard Finster used. Howard Finster could make art out of almost anything. He sometimes made art from “other people’s junk” - art from the detritus and cast-offs of life. This project focuses on repurposing found or discarded objects and using them as the raw materials for making
